name: idle-compact
description: Compacts an idle session just before its 1-hour prompt cache expires, so resuming later reloads a short summary instead of the full context.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes before compacting
idleMinutes.description: Minutes after the last turn ends before the session is compacted. Keep it under 60 so the compaction still reads from the warm cache.

minTokens.title: Minimum context tokens
minTokens.description: Skip compacting when the context is smaller than this; a small context is cheap to reload anyway.

instructions.title: Summary instructions
instructions.description: Optional text passed to the compaction, as typed after /compact.
